author: Ruhi Cenet Documentaries
description:
Come explore Antarctica with me! Message @arctic.antarctic.expeditions on Instagram for trip details and to book your spot. You can also check out Rusarc’s website: https://en.rusarc.com/flysail

This ship is taking us to the world’s most remote island: Tristan da Cunha. But our voyage is about to turn into 75 days of pure torture and put our lives at risk.
Someone among us is carrying a infectious virus called hantavirus. And within just one week, the infection will claim the life of its first victim. Then the virus will begin spreading through the ship. As new cases emerge, more deaths will follow. And the whole world will panic.
This is going to be the kind of journey that turns my hair gray. The most stressful journey of my life is about to begin.

The journey begins with 45 hours of air travel and multiple connections. We’re flying from Istanbul, Türkiye, all the way to Ushuaia, at the southern tip of Argentina. It’s a city known as “the End of the World.” From there, we’ll board
title: 30 Days on a Death Ship (A Mysterious Virus Broke Out, We Got Stranded)
